alchemy.apothecary.physical: Top-down view of an apothecary's bench: a mid-brown elm counter with a mortar and pestle and a pair of scales, rows of small drawers and brown glazed earthenware jars along the top edge.

alchemy.bench.physical: Top-down view of an alchemist's bench: a dark brown stained beech tabletop with a darker rim, cluttered with bottle-green glass flasks and a copper alembic over a small burner, jars and a skull along the top edge, black scorch marks on the top.

altar.offering.physical: Top-down view of a small offering table: a mid-brown elm top with a tiny figure at the top edge, a grey stoneware offering dish and a stub of candle in front.

altar.stone.physical: Top-down view of the stone altar: a solid blue-grey slate block, a grey felt cloth across the top, candlesticks at each end and a cross or symbol at the top edge.

anvil.block.physical: Top-down view of an anvil: a silver-grey pewter anvil with its horn pointing left, set on a round mid-brown elm stand, a hammer resting beside it.

anvil.quench_trough.physical: Top-down view of a slack tub: a squat tawny elm tub bound with silver-grey pewter hoops, filled with dark water with a rainbow sheen.

barrel.cask_rack.physical: Top-down view of a cask stillage two cells wide: two mid-brown elm casks lying side by side on a beech cradle, their round ends with taps facing the bottom edge.

barrel.wooden.physical: Top-down view of a round barrel: circular tawny elm lid made of planks, two hoops visible at the rim, a bung near the edge.

basket.hamper.physical: Top-down view of a rectangular lidded basket: closed grey-green willow lid with a fastening loop at the front and a handle at each short end.

basket.wicker.physical: Top-down view of a round basket: tightly woven tan woven reed rim, the open top heaped with produce, a bent handle arching across.

bath.plunge_pool.physical: Top-down view of a square sunken bath: a grey-veined marble rim around a pool of clear blue-green water, steps down at one corner, towels folded on one edge.

bath.wash_tub.physical: Top-down view of a round wash tub: a light brown beech tub with grey soapy water, a scrubbing board leaning in it, wet splashes on the floor around.

bath.wooden_tub.physical: Top-down view of a long oval bathing tub: amber yew staves bound with iron hoops, a cream fine linen sheet draped over the rim, steaming water inside, a stool at one end.

bed.bunk.physical: Top-down view of a two-tier plank bunk: the upper oatmeal undyed linen mattress fills the pale ash frame, a ladder on one long side, pillow at the top.

bed.double.physical: Top-down view of a double bed: light brown beech frame, a cream undyed linen quilt, two pillows side by side against the headboard at the top.

bed.double_pallet.physical: Top-down view of a broad double straw pallet lying flat on the floor: a dun coarse hemp cover with two dents side by side, two flat pillows at the top.

bed.fine_single.physical: Top-down view of a narrow curtained bed: an amber yew frame with a tall headboard at the top, a white fine linen coverlet, three stacked pillows.

bed.fourposter.physical: Top-down view of a canopied four-poster bed: four amber yew posts at the corners joined by a canopy rail, woad-blue dyed wool drapes tied back, bolster and pillows at the top.

bed.hammock.physical: Top-down view of a slung hammock: a long brown felt sling pinched at both ends, ropes running to hooks at the top and bottom.

bed.pallet.physical: Top-down view of a flat straw pallet on the floor: one flat rectangular tick of dark dun-brown sacking with a darker stitched hem all round, short green-brown rush tufts at the seams, a rolled sacking bundle for a pillow at the top.

bed.roll.physical: Top-down view of a cream undyed linen bedroll laid flat on the floor, the top corner turned back like a blanket.

bed.single.physical: Top-down view of a single bed: pale ash frame, grey wool blanket folded back, a pale pillow against the headboard at the top.

bench.long.physical: Top-down view of a long backless trestle bench: a honey ash plank three times as long as it is wide, on sturdy legs.

bench.pew.physical: Top-down view of a long pew: a tawny elm seat with its tall back along the top edge, a narrow ledge behind it, shaped ends at left and right.

bench.plank.physical: Top-down view of a backless plank bench: one long mid-brown elm board, the leg ends showing at each short edge.

bench.settle.physical: Top-down view of a boxy settle: a tawny elm seat with a tall solid back along the top edge and high arms at each end.

bench.stone.physical: Top-down view of a solid marble bench: a smooth speckled granite slab with scrolled ends at left and right.

bin.waste.physical: Top-down view of a round slop bucket: honey ash rim with scraps and crumpled rubbish inside, a lid lying askew.

board.black.physical: Top-down view of the slate board: a long thick mid-brown ash frame along the top edge holding a dark dressed sandstone slab that fills the area toward the bottom, a narrow brown wooden chalk ledge along its bottom side with two short chalk stubs.

board.map.physical: Top-down view of the map stand: a wide light brown beech board along the top edge, joined below it by a thick dark beech frame holding a stretched tanned brown leather map inked with dark routes, filling the bottom half.

board.notice.physical: Top-down view of the notice board: a light brown beech rail along the top edge, below it a dark brown cork board in a thick beech frame covered in yellowed parchment and brown paper notices, a few scraps poking past its edge.

bookcase.library.physical: Top-down view of a tall carved bookcase two cells wide: heavy reddish-brown cherrywood cornice, a ladder rail along the bottom edge with a ladder hooked at one end, rows of tan spines.

bookcase.scroll.physical: Top-down view of a scroll rack two cells wide: light brown beech frame, rows of round cubbies with scroll ends facing the bottom edge, small tags dangling.

bookcase.small.physical: Top-down view of a narrow book shelf: mid-brown elm top, a short row of book spines along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

bookcase.standard.physical: Top-down view of a bookcase two cells wide: tawny elm top, the spines of grey books visible along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

butcher.block.physical: Top-down view of a chopping block: a thick square pale ash end-grain block with a dark stained hollow in the middle, a wrought iron cleaver stuck in one corner.

butcher.hook_rail.physical: Top-down view of a butchering frame: a long black wrought iron bar along the top edge on two ash posts, hanging carcasses shown as pale shapes below it, a drip tray underneath.

cabinet.cupboard.physical: Top-down view of a cupboard: square tawny elm top, a pair of doors along the bottom edge with small pewter handles, back against the top edge.

cabinet.medicine.physical: Top-down view of a narrow physic cupboard: tawny elm top, an ash door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

cabinet.sideboard.physical: Top-down view of a long court cupboard two cells wide: reddish-brown cherrywood top with a row of silver-grey dishes and a tall jug, cupboard doors along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

cell_bed.plank.physical: Top-down view of a bare plank shelf: solid dark honey ash boards laid edge to edge with no gaps and a darker wooden rim, a thin flat mat of tan woven reed on them, a short thick iron chain at each top corner, head end at the top.

cell_bed.privileged.physical: Top-down view of a narrow tower-room bed: a reddish-brown cherrywood frame fixed to the floor, a woad-blue dyed wool blanket, a real pillow at the top.

cell_bed.slab.physical: Top-down view of a solid stone ledge: one ochre rubble stone block running from the wall at the top, smooth along its length.

chair.armchair.physical: Top-down view of a roomy great chair: wide light brown beech arms either side, a cream undyed linen seat cushion, a padded back along the top edge.

chair.high_back.physical: Top-down view of a tall high-backed chair: a tan calfskin seat in a russet yew frame, a shaped backrest along the top edge.

chair.plain.physical: Top-down view of a simple wooden chair: a square light brown beech seat with the backrest along the top edge.

chair.rocking.physical: Top-down view of a slatted rocking chair: light brown beech seat and back at the top, curved runners showing past the top and bottom edges, a grey cushion on the seat.

chest.ironbound.physical: Top-down view of a heavy banded chest: a rectangular box, longer from left to right, with a gently rounded tawny elm lid and straight square ends, three dull grey pewter bands crossing the lid from top to bottom, a large lock plate on the bottom long edge, iron studs on the four corners.

chest.strongbox.physical: Top-down view of a compact strongbox: brass lid with riveted edges, a keyhole plate on one long side, a bolt head at each corner fixing it down.

chest.trunk.physical: Top-down view of a travelling chest: mid-brown elm lid with wrought iron corners and two slats running across, a carrying handle at each short end.

chest.wooden.physical: Top-down view of a chest: plank light brown beech lid with two pewter straps across it, a simple hasp on one long edge.

coffin.bier.physical: Top-down view of a bier: a long flat dark honey ash stretcher with a thick carrying pole sticking out at each corner, a green wool cloth draped over a long rounded shape that covers it completely with no face showing, head at the top.

coffin.plain.physical: Top-down view of a coffin: a six-sided light brown beech box wider at the shoulders near the top, wrought iron handles along the sides, a lid with a simple plate.

coffin.sarcophagus.physical: Top-down view of a sarcophagus: a heavy cream polished limestone tomb chest with a lid carved as a lying figure, head at the top, feet at the bottom.

counter.bar.physical: Top-down view of a tap counter three cells wide: long tawny elm top with a few mugs and a rag, a raised lip along the bottom (customer) edge, taps and bottles along the top edge.

counter.bar_grand.physical: Top-down view of a carved tap counter three cells wide: glossy speckled granite top, a thin foot rail along the bottom edge, ranks of bottles and glasses on a back shelf along the top edge.

counter.kitchen.physical: Top-down view of a kitchen board two cells wide: mid-brown elm work surface, a chopping board and a crock of utensils near the top edge against the wall.

counter.kitchen_stone.physical: Top-down view of a stone worktop two cells wide: a single smooth rose carved sandstone slab with a faint vein pattern, a row of jars along the top edge, a folded cloth at one end.

counter.plank.physical: Top-down view of a plank counter two cells wide: three long rough golden pine boards running from left to right side by side with uneven ends, the dark ends of two trestles showing at either end.

counter.shop.physical: Top-down view of a trade counter two cells wide: honey ash top, a small till box at one end, the keeper's side along the top edge with a few wrapped parcels waiting there.

counter.shop_long.physical: Top-down view of a merchant's counter three cells wide: one unbroken mid-brown elm top, a hinged flap at the right end, scales and a ledger along the top edge on the keeper's side.

crate.stack.physical: Top-down view of a crate stack two by two cells: four light brown beech crate lids in a square, the top layer slightly offset, grey straps crossing them.

crate.wooden.physical: Top-down view of a square crate: tawny elm lid with reinforced edges and a stencilled mark in one corner.

crib.cradle.physical: Top-down view of a small cradle: an oblong honey ash box with a curved wooden hood over the head end at the top, a flat brown felt blanket folded inside, rocker tips showing at the corners.

crib.fine.physical: Top-down view of a small canopied cradle: a reddish-brown cherrywood basket with a cream quilted linen canopy drawn over the top end, a tiny pillow beneath it.

decor.armour.physical: Top-down view of the suit of armour: broad gold brass shoulders and helm seen from above, on a small golden-brown oak base, front toward the bottom.

decor.banner.physical: Top-down view of the banner stand: a weighted round mid-brown elm foot with a pole, a green wool banner hanging in folds along the top edge.

decor.fountain.physical: Top-down view of a round basin fountain: a cream polished limestone rim around rippled water, a bronze spout at the centre.

decor.globe.physical: Top-down view of the armillary sphere: a large brass sphere in a ring mount, centred on a round amber yew stand.

decor.mirror.physical: Top-down view of the polished mirror: a thin tawny elm frame on two splayed feet along the top edge, the copper face toward the bottom.

decor.painting.template: Fine linen painting on an easel [decor.painting]
decor.painting.physical: Top-down view of the painting on an easel: a three-legged reddish-brown cherrywood easel, the framed fine linen canvas a thin line along the top, its face toward the bottom.

decor.screen.physical: Seen from above at a steep three-quarter angle: a free-standing folding screen of three tall panels standing in a zigzag, each panel madder-red dyed linen in a thick mid-brown ash frame, dark iron hinges between them, the zigzag of the panel tops clearly visible.

desk.plain.physical: Top-down view of a plain clerk's table: a light brown beech top with a few papers and a pen, the back edge at the top.

desk.writing.physical: Top-down view of a broad writing desk: a reddish-brown cherrywood top with an inset chestnut tooled leather panel, an inkwell and quill, a row of pigeonholes along the top edge.

display.pedestal.physical: Top-down view of a square display plinth: speckled granite top with a narrow moulded rim, a woad-blue cushion in the centre holding a single small object.

display.table.physical: Top-down view of a market stall table two cells wide: brown felt cloth over the ash top, small goods arranged in rows, a price slate at the top edge.

display.vitrine.physical: Top-down view of a tall glazed cabinet: square reddish-brown cherrywood top with a carved cornice, the glazed door along the bottom edge, its back flat against the top edge.

feed.hay_bale.physical: Top-down view of a hay bale: a rectangular block of tan woven reed with two twine bands across it, loose stalks around the edges.

feed.stall.physical: Top-down view of a stall: three light brown beech partition walls open at the bottom edge, a manger at the top, pale wicker covering the floor.

feed.trough.physical: Top-down view of a trough: a long narrow light brown beech trough holding tan woven reed or water.

firewood.kindling_basket.physical: Top-down view of a round kindling basket: a woven tan woven reed rim, a jumble of thin pale ash sticks and split logs inside.

firewood.log_stack.physical: Top-down view of a log stack against the top wall: rows of round pale ash log ends stacked neatly, bark curls and wood chips scattered at the bottom edge.

forge.hearth.physical: Top-down view of a smith's forge: a raised blue-grey slate hearth with a bright orange firepot in the middle, a black wrought iron hood over the top edge, a bellows or blower at one end and tongs hung on the side.

forge.pit.physical: Top-down view of a pit forge: a low ring of ochre rubble stone around glowing orange coals, a small tan rawhide bellows pointing in from one side.

game.cards.physical: Top-down view of a square dice table: a brown felt playing surface edged in light brown beech, a scatter of cards and coins at the centre.

game.chess.physical: Top-down view of a small square chess table: an inlaid checkered honey ash board with pieces mid-game, a chair at the top and bottom edges.

gym.pell.physical: Top-down view of a pell: a thick round mid-brown elm post set in a limestone base, the top chewed with sword cuts.

hearth.brazier.physical: Top-down view of a round brazier: a black wrought iron bowl heaped with red-hot coals, three short legs just visible at the rim, a faint ring of ash on the floor around it.

hearth.fire_pit.physical: Top-down view of a round fire pit: a ring of blue-grey slate stones around glowing orange embers and grey ash, a few half-burnt sticks crossing the middle.

hearth.fireplace.physical: Top-down view of a wall hearth: an ochre dressed sandstone hearth slab jutting from the top edge, a dark firebox against the back wall with a copper grate of burning logs, a raised hearthstone along the bottom.

hearth.great_fireplace.physical: Top-down view of a wide great fireplace against the top wall: a long cream polished limestone surround, a deep firebox roaring with flame, a honey oak mantel shelf along the back edge, a broad hearthstone in front.

hospital_bed.cot.physical: Top-down view of a plain infirmary cot: pale ash frame, a cream undyed linen sheet pulled straight, a small pillow at the top.

hospital_bed.curtained.physical: Top-down view of a screened curtained sickbed: reddish-brown cherrywood frame and bolster at the top, green dyed wool curtains drawn round three sides on a rail.

hydroponics.potting_table.physical: Top-down view of a planting table: a tawny elm table with heaps of dark soil, small grey stoneware pots of green seedlings, a trowel and watering can, stacked pots along the top edge.

instrument.great_drum.physical: Top-down view of the great drum: a round grey sheepskin drumhead laced to a honey ash shell, a padded beater resting across it.

instrument.harp.physical: Seen from above at a steep three-quarter angle: a floor harp laid flat on its side so its whole outline shows, a tall triangle with a thick straight dark stained ash sound box along the bottom, a curved ash neck along the top and a straight front pillar, dark bronze strings in parallel lines between neck and sound box.

instrument.organ.physical: Top-down view of the pipe organ: a row of silver-grey polished steel pipe tops along the top edge, a honey oak console with stepped keyboards and a bench toward the bottom.

kiln.brick.physical: Top-down view of a brick kiln: a thick-walled square of blue-grey slate with a chimney at the top edge, an arched wrought iron door at the bottom edge and fire ports on both sides.

kiln.clay.physical: Top-down view of a clay kiln: a round yellow glazed earthenware dome with a smoke hole in the middle, a small firing mouth at the bottom edge, ringed by pale grey limestone.

lathe.pole.physical: Top-down view of a pole lathe: a long mid-brown elm bed with two upright centres holding a turning blank, a willow cord running up to the top edge, a treadle and shavings below.

lathe.potters_wheel.physical: Top-down view of a potter's wheel: a round pale grey limestone wheel head with a wet clay pot in the middle, an elm seat at the bottom edge, a water bowl beside it.

lathe.saw_bench.physical: Top-down view of a sawing trestle: a rectangular tawny elm table with a pewter blade slot along the middle, a fence along one side, sawdust heaped below.

lectern.pulpit.physical: Top-down view of the pulpit: a six-sided cream polished limestone box on a raised base, a short stair at one side, a cream fine linen cloth draped over the front edge toward the bottom.

lectern.reading.physical: Top-down view of the lectern: a tawny elm column with a slanted reading top, the high edge at the top, the speaker's side toward the bottom.

light.candelabrum.physical: Top-down view of a floor candelabrum: a heavy round dark gold bronze base disc, seven short candles in a ring and one in the centre on bronze arms radiating like spokes, each candle top a small lit flame.

light.candle.physical: Top-down view of a candle stand: a small round silver-grey pewter drip pan with a single lit candle in the middle, a soft yellow halo around it.

light.lantern.physical: Top-down view of a horn lantern: a square or round silver-grey pewter cap with a carrying handle, light spilling through brownish forest glass sides onto the floor around it.

light.oil_lamp.physical: Top-down view of a small light brown beech stand with an oil lamp: a brown stoneware lamp seen from above, a single flame at its spout and a ring of warm light.

light.torch.physical: Top-down view of a torch stand: a round dull grey pewter base and cup holding a burning torch head, orange flame and a smudge of soot on the floor around it.

locker.footlocker.physical: Top-down view of a low kit chest: rectangular honey ash lid with a stencilled number, two grey straps across it, a handle at either end.

loom.floor.physical: Top-down view of a floor loom: a square mid-brown elm frame with brown warp threads running from top to bottom, treadles and a weaver's bench at the bottom edge, woven cloth rolled at the bottom.

loom.spinning_wheel.physical: Seen from above at a steep three-quarter angle: a spinning wheel, a large spoked honey ash wheel standing upright at one end of a low slanted ash bench, a spindle with a russet wool bobbin at the other end, nothing else around it.

medical.herbalist_table.physical: Top-down view of a herbalist's table: a pale ash table with bundles of honey wicker laid out, small bowls, a mortar and rolled bandages, herb bunches hanging along the top edge.

medical.operating_table.physical: Top-down view of a surgeon's board: a narrow tawny elm table on an ash base, a head rest at the top, arm boards to each side, a tray of instruments beside it.

mill.grindstone.physical: Top-down view of a grindstone: a round buff dressed sandstone wheel seen edge-on as a thick bar, mounted in an elm frame with a crank or motor on one side, a water trough or tray below.

mill.millstones.physical: Top-down view of a millstones: a large round reddish-brown cherrywood casing around a broad honey carved sandstone millstone, a grain hopper over the centre, a flour chute at the bottom edge.

mill.quern.physical: Top-down view of a quern: two stacked round blue-grey slate millstones with a hole in the middle, an upright elm handle near the rim, a ring of flour around the base.

nightstand.crate.physical: Top-down view of a small upturned crate: a square yellowish knotty fir box turned on end, a few small objects on its top.

nightstand.fine.physical: Top-down view of a fine carved night cabinet: a cream polished limestone top over an amber yew cabinet, a small keyhole on the bottom edge.

nightstand.plain.physical: Top-down view of a small bedside table: a square pale ash top, a drawer pull showing on the bottom edge.

oven.bakehouse.physical: Top-down view of a large baker's oven: a broad blue-grey slate block against the top wall with a vaulted roof, a wide copper oven mouth on the bottom edge, a stone apron and a long peel in front.

oven.bread_oven.physical: Top-down view of a bread oven: a rounded brown glazed earthenware dome filling the square, a flat front lip at the bottom with a small ruddy copper door and a wooden peel leaning beside it.

plant.herb_pot.physical: Top-down view of a round grey stoneware pot of herbs seen from above: a tight clump of pale leaves filling the rim.

plant.potted.physical: Top-down view of the potted shrub: a round grey stoneware pot almost hidden under a spray of honey wicker fronds.

plant.tree.physical: Top-down view of the tubbed orange tree: a square honey ash planter under a wide round crown of tan leaves that spills past its edges.

press.fruit.physical: Top-down view of a cider press: a round slatted mid-brown elm basket with a pressing plate and wrought iron screw on top, a spout and bucket at the bottom edge.

press.printing.physical: Top-down view of a screw press: a light brown beech frame with a flat wrought iron bed sliding out toward the bottom, a long lever arm to one side, stacked paper and an ink slab along the top edge.

rack.clothing.physical: Top-down view of a hanging pole two cells wide: a straight mid-brown elm bar across the middle with a crowded row of hanging brown clothes seen from above, feet at either end.

rack.coat.physical: Top-down view of a peg stand: small round light brown beech base, a central post with four hooks pointing outward, a coat draped over one side.

rack.drying.physical: Top-down view of a folding drying frame: parallel tawny elm rails with russet sheets and shirts draped over them.

rack.tool.physical: Top-down view of a tool rack: pale ash board against the top edge with pewter hand tools hung on a row of pegs, a narrow tray of fixings along the bottom.

rack.weapon.physical: Top-down view of a weapon rack: honey ash frame against the top edge with a row of notches, the tips of three long weapons leaning back into it, a wrought iron bar locking them in place.

rack.wine.physical: Top-down view of a wine rack: light brown beech lattice against the top edge, bottle necks pointing toward the bottom edge in neat rows.

religious.candle_rack.physical: Top-down view of the votive candle stand: a stepped black wrought iron tray filled with rows of small lit candles, a sand tray at the front toward the bottom.

religious.font.physical: Top-down view of the font: a round pale grey limestone basin on an eight-sided base, a light brown beech lid with a knob at its centre.

religious.prayer_mat.physical: Top-down view of the prayer mat: a small oblong of brown felt with a pointed arch motif at the top end and a fringe at the bottom.

rug.carpet.physical: Top-down view of a large oblong knotted carpet: saffron quilted linen centre with a central medallion, a wide cream border, fringe along the short sides.

rug.hide.physical: Top-down view of the hide rug: a brown animal pelt spread flat, four legs splayed to the corners, head at the top.

rug.mat.physical: Top-down view of a small oblong rush mat: tan woven reed in rough bands, frayed ends at left and right.

rug.runner.physical: Top-down view of a long narrow runner running from top to bottom: flat woven madder-red dyed linen with a dark brown stripe down each long edge and a dark brown border at each end.

rug.woven.physical: Top-down view of a square woven rug: brown felt field, a plain contrasting border, short fringe at the top and bottom edges.

sack.grain.physical: Top-down view of a slumped grain sack: lumpy brown felt bag with its tied neck flopped to one side, a little spilled grain beside it.

shelf.boutique.physical: Top-down view of a carved wall shelf two cells wide: slim russet yew frame, a yew shelf with a few widely spaced objects, decorative moulding along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

shelf.goods.physical: Top-down view of a shallow stock shelf two cells wide: light brown beech shelf edge along the bottom, back panel against the top edge, rows of jars, boxes and bundles packed tight.

shelf.pantry.physical: Top-down view of a larder shelf two cells wide: tawny elm shelf edge along the bottom, rows of yellow glazed earthenware jars and tied bundles, back against the top edge.

sink.scullery.physical: Top-down view of a long stone sink against the top wall: a shallow rectangular blue-grey slate trough with a drain hole at one end, a bucket and scrubbing brush on the rim.

sink.wash_basin.physical: Top-down view of a wash basin: a round tawny elm bowl of water on a square honey ash stool, a folded rag and a jug beside it.

sink.washstand.physical: Top-down view of a laver: a cream polished limestone top with a round yellow majolica basin sunk in the middle, a tall ewer at the back edge, a folded towel hanging from the side rail.

sofa.daybed.physical: Top-down view of a long daybed: a green dyed wool seat with a curved raised end at the left, a short back rail along the top edge, reddish-brown cherrywood feet.

sofa.settle_cushioned.physical: Top-down view of a padded cushioned settle: a honey ash frame with a high back along the top edge, grey wool cushions along the seat.

statue.bust.template: Dressed sandstone bust on a pedestal [statue.bust]
statue.bust.physical: Top-down view of the bust on a pedestal: a square pale ash pedestal topped by a buff dressed sandstone head and shoulders, face toward the bottom.

statue.carving.physical: Top-down view of a small honey ash carved figure on a squat base: a rough human shape, head at the top.

statue.figure.physical: Top-down view of the statue: a square cream polished limestone plinth with a speckled granite standing figure, head and shoulders central, raised arm reaching to one side.

still.brew_kettle.physical: Top-down view of a brewing copper: a large round ruddy copper kettle with a steaming open top, set into a blue-grey slate firebox, a ladle hooked on the rim.

still.pot.physical: Top-down view of an alembic: a round black wrought iron pot with a domed top, a pewter pipe coiling into a cooling bucket beside it, a jug under the spout.

still.vat.physical: Top-down view of a fermenting tun: a wide round pale ash vat bound with wrought iron hoops, a loose lid and a paddle laid across the top.

stool.ottoman.physical: Top-down view of a padded cushioned stool: a square saffron quilted linen top with buttoned tufts and short honey oak feet at the corners.

stool.plain.physical: Top-down view of a small three-legged stool: a round tawny elm seat, the tips of its legs just showing.

stove.cookfire.physical: Top-down view of a cooking fire: a ring of blue-grey slate stones around glowing coals, a round copper cauldron in the middle seen from above with a ladle in it, the tripod's three legs reaching out to the corners.

stove.kitchen_hearth.physical: Top-down view of a long kitchen hearth against the top wall: a red dressed sandstone hearth bed of fire, a spit with a roast across it, a ruddy copper pot crane swung out over the flames, a flagstone apron along the bottom.

table.dining.physical: Top-down view of a square dining table: a light brown beech top with a runner down the middle, one leg at each corner.

table.long.physical: Top-down view of a very long feasting table: a honey oak top twice as long as it is wide, a line of serving dishes down the middle.

table.plank.physical: Top-down view of a plain plank table: a rectangular tawny elm top, twice as wide as it is deep, legs at the corners.

table.round_small.physical: Top-down view of a small round table: a round tawny elm top on a single central post.

table.side.physical: Top-down view of a small square carved side table: a cream polished limestone top with a bevelled edge, slim russet yew legs at the corners.

table.trestle.physical: Top-down view of a long trestle table: three light brown beech boards side by side, resting on X-shaped trestles at each end.

throne.gilded.physical: Top-down view of a richly ornate gilded throne: gold gilded bronze frame with flared arms, a deep red velvet seat, a fan-shaped back along the top edge.

throne.state.physical: Top-down view of a grand throne: a cream quilted linen seat between heavy russet yew arms, a tall crested back along the top edge.

throne.stone.physical: Top-down view of a massive stone throne: a blocky cream polished limestone seat and back along the top edge, a fawn deerskin hide draped over the seat.

toilet.chamber_pot.physical: Top-down view of a small round chamber pot: a brown stoneware pot with a curled handle on one side, a wooden lid half over it, on bare floor.

toilet.close_stool.physical: Top-down view of a boxy close stool: a square tawny elm chest with a hinged lid along the back edge, a green wool cushion on top, a carrying handle on each side.

utility.ladder.physical: Top-down view of a folded ladder: two long mid-brown elm rails with rungs between them, a paint-spattered top step.

utility.mop_bucket.physical: Top-down view of a pail and broom: a round pale ash bucket of murky water with a wringer at one side, a long light brown beech handle angled across the square.

wardrobe.armoire.physical: Top-down view of a massive carved armoire two cells wide: reddish-brown cherrywood top edged with carved moulding and silver-grey polished steel inlay, doors along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.narrow.physical: Top-down view of a slim clothes cupboard: square light brown beech top, a single door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.standard.physical: Top-down view of a clothes press two cells wide: flat mid-brown elm top with a hatbox at one end, double doors with wrought iron handles along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

workbench.cutting_table.physical: Top-down view of a cutting table: a smooth light brown beech top with a length of grey felt spread across it, shears, chalk and pins, a rack of bolts along the top edge.

workbench.joiner.physical: Top-down view of a joiner's bench: a heavy light brown beech top with a row of bench-dog holes, a wrought iron screw vise at the right end, a shelf of planes and chisels along the top edge.

workbench.master.physical: Top-down view of a long master's workbench: a broad russet yew top with two vises, a brass rule set into the near edge, rows of small drawers and hung tools along the top edge.

workbench.rough.physical: Top-down view of a trestle bench: a long pale rough pine plank top resting on two split birch supports, a few loose tools and shavings on it, a strip of nails along the top edge.
